regime: Risk-Off Lean into the Fed, Equities Dip and Recover
summary: Quiet on the calendar, busy under the surface. Stocks sold off overnight, with NQ flushing to 28,816 and ES to 7,595, then bought back through the day session to close only modestly red. NQ finished down 0.67 percent at 29,195 and ES down 0.38 percent at 7,632, both holding just above their trend stops after the round trip. Gold went the other way, down 1.13 percent to 4,340 on the December contract and flipping below its stop. Crude popped to 104.94 overnight then faded all day to close 101.88, back under its own stop, a failed bounce. VIX ticked up about 8 percent to 17.1, still a calm level. This was a positioning day. The Fed meets Tuesday and Wednesday.
psychology: Slow news days into a big event are their own trap. There was no scheduled release today, so the tape drifted and chopped, and that is exactly when traders talk themselves into marginal setups out of boredom. The overnight flush and the day session recovery gave two clean stories in one session, and if you traded both with size you probably paid for it. The better play this week is patience. The Fed decision Wednesday is the real catalyst, and nothing you force on Monday or Tuesday changes that. Size down, keep your list of levels, and let the event come to you. Waiting is a position.

event.name: No scheduled US release (pre-FOMC positioning day)
event.actual: There was no scheduled US economic release today, so the driver was positioning ahead of the Fed. The two day FOMC meeting starts Tuesday September 15 and ends Wednesday September 16, with the rate decision and a fresh set of economic projections at 2:00 pm ET Wednesday. August Retail Sales is also on the docket this week.
event.surprise: Tape leaned defensive into the Fed: stocks sold off overnight before recovering, gold lost its trend stop, crude's bounce faded, and VIX ticked up to 17.1.
event.nqReaction: NQ flushed to a 28,816 overnight low, opened weak at the bell, then broke up out of its opening range and recovered to close 29,195, back above its reset trend stop.
event.crossAsset: December gold fell 1.13 percent to 4,340 and flipped below its stop. Crude popped to 104.94 overnight then faded to 101.88, below its stop. VIX rose about 8 percent to 17.1.

risk.sizing: The tape whipsawed today and the Fed decision lands Wednesday, so this is a keep it small backdrop. VIX ticked up, gold and crude flipped below their stops, and the indices only just held above theirs. This is not a size up spot.
risk.openRisk: For the indices the reset stops are the line. MNQ holding above 29,016 or MES above 7,598 on two hourly closes keeps the recovery intact, and below those the short term trend flips back down toward 28,956 then 28,816 on NQ. Upside references are the 29,306 RTH high and the 29,500 zone on NQ, and 7,652 then 7,700 on ES. December gold flipped below its 4,362 stop, so it is a with trend short toward 4,300 until it reclaims 4,362, with 4,400 above. Crude flipped below its 104.19 stop, so it is a with trend short toward 100.53 and the 100 round until it reclaims 104.19.
risk.note: Rising event risk into the FOMC decision Wednesday September 16 with fresh projections. This was the quiet setup day before the Fed. Keep size sensible and mind prop news blackout rules around the Fed decision Wednesday. Not financial advice.

fullReport.title: NY Opening Range / HTA OPEN
fullReport.html: NQ printed a tight 74 point opening range at the 9:30 bell: high 28,954, low 28,880, near the session lows. Price broke up out of that range and rallied all day, tagging a 29,306 RTH high and closing 29,195, above NYVWAP 29,164. In plain terms the market opened weak, found buyers, and worked higher off the low. For Tuesday the opening range resets fresh. BIR, HOF, MID, and BNC are all eligible on the calendar, subject to their time windows, with HOF and MID sitting out the Wednesday Fed decision day.

fullReport.title: Momentum Breakout (Regime Filter)
fullReport.html: E3v2 Momentum Long is marginally armed. NQ and ES both closed back above their trend stops, so the index momentum filter is on the long side again, but both closed red after a flush and recovery. A fresh 15 minute breakout long is on the table only if price holds above the reset stops. Gold and crude are the opposite, both below falling stops, so no long there. A day before the Fed decision is a spot to want confirmation before pressing a new long.

fullReport.title: AVWAP Deviation Band Reversal
fullReport.html: AVWAP deviation band (MNQ): AVWAP center 29,182, close 29,195 is right on the mean. Bands: plus 2 sigma 29,361, plus 1 sigma 29,272, minus 1 sigma 29,093, minus 2 sigma 29,003, minus 3 sigma 28,913. Sigma widened to about 90 today from Friday's 27 after the wide overnight range. Volume is unavailable on the continuous contract, so this is price only. The close sits on the AVWAP, so there is no stretched extreme to fade here. The band is a map for Tuesday: a push to plus 2 sigma near 29,361 or a flush to minus 2 sigma near 29,003 are the spots this edge looks to fade, best after price stops trending.
